name: pump.fun daily
summary: Each morning sends yesterday's pump.fun launches, graduations, volume, busiest coins and odds, via pumpdata.fun. Free, read-only. Not affiliated with pump.fun.
summary_zh: 每天早上发送 pump.fun 昨日概况，包括发币数、毕业数、交易量、最活跃的币和各市值段的概率，数据来自 pumpdata.fun 免费接口。免费使用，只读，不交易。与 pump.fun 无关联。
